record.label: Spacetime cost of the 333-qubit circuit
record.statement: Appendix I.4 reports 333 logical qubits and 1,310,839,337 T gates, with a product of 436,509,499,221 qubit–T.
record.boundary: The Lean count assigns zero T gates to a measurement and takes the larger of the two T counts in a measurement-dependent conditional. At 333 logical qubits, the proved product bound gives a T count of at most 1,310,839,337.
